value.body: Government physiotherapists work in central and state hospitals, AIIMS and other central institutes, ESIC hospitals, the railways and sports bodies. The work is mostly rehabilitation — post-surgery, neurological, cardiac and sports injuries — in out-patient and ward settings.

items.label: Usual qualification
items.note: Some posts also ask for experience or an MPT

items.label: Regulation
items.value: National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions Act, 2021
items.note: Physiotherapy is a listed allied health profession

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A BPT degree (and any experience the notice asks for). Each employer recruits separately: Railway Recruitment Boards (paramedical categories), AIIMS and other central institutes, ESIC, and state health departments or recruitment boards through their own notifications and tests.

value.title: At a glance
items: Posts are few and notified irregularly, so candidates usually watch several employers at once.
Exams test core physiotherapy subjects plus general aptitude, depending on the recruiter.
Government posts offer stable pay-matrix salaries; private hospitals and clinics hire far more physiotherapists.
